subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve full agent ID with colon in session key

question: Should OpenClaw support agent IDs containing `:` inside canonical `agent:<agentId>:<rest>` session keys?
rationale: The current grammar uses `:` as its structural delimiter across the shared parser and callers, so making embedded colons valid requires a deliberate format and compatibility decision rather than a one-call-site repair.

options.title: Keep the current delimiter contract
options.body: Reject colon-containing agent IDs as unsupported and close or withdraw this parser substitution because it cannot change the parsed result.

options.title: Design explicit colon-ID support
options.body: Approve a versioned or unambiguous session-key encoding, then update canonical parsing, key production, validation, migration guidance, and focused end-to-end coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep the current delimiter contract
recommendation.body: Reject colon-containing agent IDs as unsupported and close or withdraw this parser substitution because it cannot change the parsed result.

likelyOwner.reason: A confirmed owner could not be established from the available feature-history evidence; the decision belongs with the team responsible for the canonical session-key contract.
